'''Jeral Vesk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where he tasked an Imperial individual to investigate several points where [[House Rist]] ambushers are planning to kill Imperial and [[House of Thul|House Thul]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]].<ref name="TOR" />
